description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This Suzuki OEM part attaches to the outside door frame and keeps water and wind from entering around the bottom of the door glass.
These Scrapes come with the clips pre-fitted.
They can be installed by simply pushing them down into the glass opening until the clips lock into place.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Outside Door Scrapes LH & RH
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
